title: The Cosmic Bell Ringer
description: A colossal muscular titan stands at the center of a cosmic vortex, holding a large golden bell high in his right hand. His body is covered in intricate glowing circuitry patterns as books, papers, and staircases emerge from his torso and splash into turbulent blue waves at his waist.
prompt: A massive muscular titan made of dark stone and glowing golden circuitry stands in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex, holding a large ornate golden bell aloft in his right hand while books and papers cascade from his body into turbulent ocean waves at his waist, dramatic light rays shining from the bell, surrounded by stars, nebulae and floating architectural fragments in a highly detailed surreal fantasy style
